reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Ishlab chiqaruvchi yoki diler xati talabi (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 8 bo'yicha ishlab chiqaruvchidan diler sertifikati, ishonchnoma yoki avtorizatsiya xati majburiy, aks holda ishtirokchi chetlatiladi; o'tish bali 8 bo'lgani uchun bu mezon ham qolganlari kabi hal qiluvchi. Lot narxi 7 820 000 000 so'm. Mezon sarlavhasi esa foydalanilgan tovar haqida, shu sababli talab matni bilan mos kelmaydi. Ishlab chiqaruvchi bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'lanmagan, lekin asl tovarni yetkaza oladigan ta'minotchilar chetda qolishi mumkin.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib tajriba yoki resurs talabi (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 5 bo'yicha oldingi o'xshash yetkazib berishlar haqida yakuniy foydalanuvchining tavsiya xati kerak, bo'lmasa ishtirokchi chetlatiladi (1 ball, o'tish bali 8). Hujjatda necha yetkazib berish yoki qaysi muddat kerakligi aytilmagan va tavsiya xatini boshqa tashkilotdan olish ishtirokchi nazoratida emas. Savol: o'tgan shartnoma va dalolatnoma nusxalari yetarlimi?

Haddan tashqari tor texnik parametrlar (2-bet): Optik televyuver uchun uzunlik, diametr, vazn, sensor o'lchami, yorug'lik oqimi va 4 tomirli kabel kabi ko'p parametr bir vaqtda juda aniq berilgan va mosligi qanday talab (mavjud Robertson Geo stansiyalari bilan ulanish) ekanligi matnda aniq yozilmagan. Bu kombinatsiya bitta modelga mos kelishi mumkin; mos keladigan ekvivalentlar qabul qilinishini aniqlash tavsiya etiladi.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 62 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 2 ta; savdolarning 73% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 15%.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Manufacturer or dealer letter required (platform criteria form): Criterion 8 makes a dealer certificate, power of attorney or authorisation letter from the manufacturer mandatory, and the bidder is excluded without it; with a pass mark of 8 this criterion is as decisive as any other. The lot start price is 7,820,000,000 UZS. The criterion title is about used goods, so it does not match the requirement text. Suppliers who can deliver genuine goods without a direct tie to the manufacturer may be shut out.

Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot (platform criteria form): Criterion 5 requires a reference letter from an end user for prior similar supplies, and the bidder is excluded without it (1 point, pass mark 8). The document does not say how many supplies or what period is needed, and getting a letter from another organisation is outside the bidder's control. Worth asking whether copies of past contracts and acceptance acts would be enough.

Over-narrow technical parameters (page 2): For the optical televiewer, many parameters (length, diameter, weight, sensor size, light output, 4-conductor cable) are given together with great precision, and the text does not state clearly that the real need is compatibility with the existing Robertson Geo stations. The combination may fit a single model; it is worth confirming that equivalents meeting the interface need are accepted.
In the customer's last 62 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 73% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 15%.
